# AURUM Premium Mobility Service

> Private airport transfer service in Seoul, South Korea, using a Tesla Cybertruck and premium vehicles. Serves Incheon (ICN) and Gimpo (GMP) airports with an English-speaking driver, flight tracking and meet & greet.

- Service: Private airport transfer in Seoul by Tesla Cybertruck, with Kia Carnival Hi-Limousine, Genesis Limousine, Mercedes-Benz S-Class and a limousine coach for groups.
- Airports: Incheon International Airport (ICN, Terminal 1 and 2) and Gimpo International Airport (GMP), arrivals and departures.
- Service area: Anywhere in Seoul within 60 km of the airport, including Myeongdong, Gangnam, Hongdae, Itaewon and Jamsil.
- Price: Standard $120 and Premium $180 per vehicle (launch offer). Night 22:00–06:00 +$20, extra stop +$20, round trip +$70.
- Capacity: Cybertruck: up to 4 passengers and 8 suitcases. Larger groups: Carnival, limousine coach.
- Included: English-speaking driver, flight tracking, 60 minutes free waiting, name-sign meet & greet, photo moment.
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Book by message or online form.
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +82-10-3047-9218 · KakaoTalk aurumdrive · WeChat aurumdrive · Instagram @aurumdrive.seoul
